visual_goal: Show Part I as a chain of business questions that become architectural inputs, with the ecosystem also feeding sources of truth straight into the bounded contexts, all leading into the rest of the book.
prompt: A left-to-right chain of four rounded panels, each with a simple icon. Far left: a network of small connected nodes around a generic car, labeled 'Ecosystem'. Next: a stack of coins beside a small calculator, labeled 'Economics'. Next: a grid of small tiles, labeled 'Capability map'. Next: a set of three bordered regions like a simple territory map, labeled 'Bounded contexts'. One arrow from 'Ecosystem' to 'Economics'. One arrow from 'Economics' to 'Capability map'. One arrow from 'Capability map' to 'Bounded contexts'. One long curved arrow above the chain from 'Ecosystem' to 'Bounded contexts', labeled 'sources of truth'. At the far right, a wide doorway opening onto a road, labeled 'Parts II–IX', with one arrow from 'Bounded contexts' into it. These seven labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A chain from Ecosystem to Economics to Capability map to Bounded contexts, with a curved 'sources of truth' arrow from Ecosystem straight to Bounded contexts, leading into Parts II–IX.
